description:
Deprecated alias of fareseal_agents. Same data; use the /v1/fareseal/ path. Original description follows.

Spec 125, the agent conduct record. Every agent public key that an
attested tollbooth site reported, with its summed request count,
newest first. Free, no auth, attested tier only. Facts, not verdicts:
no score, no tier, no IP. Counts are a LOWER BOUND (an evicted entry or
a restarted isolate loses history tollbooth never reported).

Use this tool when:
- You want to know which agents the commons has a record for.
- You are picking a key to read with `agent_record`.

Returns:
- `agents[]`: `{key, ua, requests, isolates, first_seen, last_seen}`.
- `count`, `limit`, and the honesty fields `counts_are`, `counts_note`, `scope`, `would_have_paid_usd`, `verify`.

Cost:
- Free. Anonymous 10/min per IP, no daily cap.

Latency:
- Typical: <100ms.

limit.description: Keys to return; above 100 clamps to 100.

name: tollbooth_agents
